phases.notes: THREE additive #ifndef CBM_FORK_CLI_ONLY blocks in mcp.c (not two): (A) JSON-RPC parse/format region [orig 227-354]; (B) MCP-protocol response builders mcp_tools_cursor_offset + cbm_mcp_tools_list_page + the prompts/list & prompts/get cluster [orig 1080-1303]; (C) session/auto-index cluster + cbm_mcp_jsonrpc_response_prepend_notice + cbm_mcp_server_handle + read_bounded_line/parse_content_length + cbm_mcp_read_message + poll_for_input_unix + cbm_mcp_server_run [orig 17373-18086]. Region B was REQUIRED (not in the plan's 2-region sketch) because tools_list_page/prompts_list/prompt_get and their static helpers are reached ONLY from the router; leaving them while guarding the router orphans static functions -> -Werror -Wunused-function. Deviations from plan T1.2's helper list, driven by the real call graph: cbm_mcp_server_request_scope_begin is called by the ENGINE (cbm_mcp_handle_tool:17350) so it STAYS unguarded (guarding it would break the engine); cbm_mcp_cancel_request_matches and cbm_mcp_server_cancel_active are extern with only transport callers -> left unguarded (harmless unused externs, no -Werror); cbm_mcp_initialize_response_for_profile + SUPPORTED_PROTOCOL_VERSIONS + MCP_*_INSTRUCTIONS STAY because cbm_mcp_initialize_response (used by tests/test_mcp.c) calls _for_profile. mcp.h: guarded the jsonrpc fn decls (44-52) and read_message/server_run/server_handle decls (198-211); jsonrpc structs left unguarded for src/daemon/frontend.c. T1.4 proven: mcp.c compiled clean under -Werror with -DCBM_FORK_CLI_ONLY=1 (no undefined-symbol / unused-static), so the engine references no guarded transport symbol. Graph tools (search_graph/trace_path) were UNAVAILABLE this session (mcp__codebase-memory-mcp__* = no such tool / CONNECTION_CLOSED); seam confirmed via Grep/Read + the guarded compile.
